description: This file defines a specialized grain class for Orleans testing, inheriting from a generic grain class with a double type parameter. It overrides the Transform method to modify the grain's value by doubling it.

classes.name: SpecializedSimpleGenericGrain
classes.description: A specialized Orleans grain class that inherits from SimpleGenericGrain with double as the type parameter.

methods.name: Transform
methods.description: Overrides the Transform method to double the 'Value' property and completes immediately.
